hooks.command: jq 'if (.prompt // "" | contains("<github-webhook-activity>")) then {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "UserPromptSubmit", additionalContext: "Before acting on this webhook event: fetch the current state of the referenced GitHub object (PR comment, review, issue, run, commit) via the GitHub REST API before reasoning.
